title: INI linter
brief:
Build a Python 3 stdlib command-line INI linter at src/inilint.py (no third-party packages).

Usage: python3 src/inilint.py <file.ini>

Accept a small INI dialect:
- A [section] line starts a section. Section names are non-empty and case-sensitive.
- A key = value line belongs to the current section. Keys are non-empty; values may be empty. Ignore surrounding spaces around the key and value.
- Blank lines and lines whose first non-space character is # or ; are ignored. There are no inline comments, so # or ; inside a value is part of the value.

Print ok and exit 0 when the file is valid. Otherwise print one line per problem to stderr as line <n>: <message> and exit 1. Problems are: a key/value line before any section, a malformed line, a duplicate key in the same section, or an empty section name. A missing file exits 2.
